description: A copper concentrator on a weak, staged grid connection: the mine feeds 800 → 1000 → 1200 t/h of ore over 2027, 2030 and 2035 through a crusher, a coarse-ore stockpile, 2 (then 3) mill lines and flotation to a concentrate shed that loads a vessel every 21 days. The 2027 connection is non-firm (25 MW, curtailed to 15 MW in 300 h), firm from 2030; PV and BESS candidates per period. Planned on the hourly chronological year, so the shed carries across shipments.

ledger.note: stage_network(time_base='year') (ticket 09, D4): every weighting 1, so the shed carries concentrate across the 21-day cycle; the representative-week build is refused (inventory_cadence_needs_year). The same synthetic year repeats in each period

study_notes: Each period is one chronological year of hours, so the concentrate shed fills over 21 days and empties at each vessel.
The mills and flotation are fixed-size units; the plan sizes PV, BESS and the stockpile extension.
Planning dispatches the process units as a plain LP; the binary operational check after the solve re-solves one week per season with their minimum load and min up / down.
A shortfall at a vessel is lost concentrate, valued at 1,300 EUR/t.
